financial_health.claim: Cash flow quality in the third quarter was mixed. Cash flows provided by operating activities were 7,547, below cash flow from operations after taxes paid of 8,142 (table in USD million).

financial_health.basis: inferred from balance sheet figures; no maturity schedule is in the packet

Shareholder distributions are a claim on cash alongside debt service. The company announced a third-quarter dividend of USD 0.39 per share and a 2026 buy-back of up to USD 3 billion.
quotes: Third quarter cash dividend of USD 0.39 per share
Share buy-back of up to USD 3 billion for 2026

financial_health.basis: stated in a balance sheet footnote

quotes: Includes collateral deposits of USD 2.4 billion as at 30 September 2026 related to certain requirements set out by exchanges where Equinor is participating.

financial_health.basis: stated in the company release; the cash-flow effect is inferred
financial_health.claim: A recent operational setback weighs on near-term cash generation. Equinor cut its 2026 production growth guidance back to around 3 percent from around 4 percent after shut-ins at Bacalhau and Visund. These are expected to reduce average production by 15-20 mboe per day for the year.
quotes: Equinor changes its production guidance back to around 3 percent growth for 2026

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 2026 6-K production figures and commentary.
growth_thesis.claim: Higher oil and gas production is a growth driver. Q3 2026 equity production was 2,166 mboe per day against 2,130 a year earlier (2%), and nine-month production was 2,214 against 2,116 (5%). The report credits new fields (Halten East, Verdande), Adura in the UK and Bacalhau in Brazil. For it to continue, new fields must keep offsetting natural decline and unplanned losses.
quotes: Equinor delivered high production in the third quarter with a total equity production of 2,166 mboe per day.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 25 November 2026 6-K exhibit, repeated in a secondary press copy.
growth_thesis.claim: The November shut-ins show what must hold for production growth to continue: safe restarts at Bacalhau and Visund and restored offloading at Johan Castberg. Equinor cut its 2026 production growth guidance back to around 3 percent from around 4 percent. It expects the shut-ins to reduce average production by 15-20 mboe per day for the year.
quotes: Temporary shut-ins at Bacalhau and Visund are expected to reduce the average production by 15-20 mboe per day for the year.
The incidents have no impact on recoverable reserves.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 2026 group review tables. The attribution of profit growth to price is inferred from the price and revenue figures together.
growth_thesis.claim: Higher realised prices drove most of the profit growth. Brent averaged 97.0 USD/bbl in Q3 2026 against 69.1, the group liquids price was 92.3 against 64.9, and the E&P Norway internal gas price was 18.07 against 9.98 USD/mmbtu. Adjusted operating income was 12,353 against 6,215 (table in USD million). For this to continue, prices must stay well above 2025 levels.
quotes: Equinor delivered an adjusted operating income* of USD 12.35 billion in the third quarter of 2026.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the segment table and the headline. The sustainability conditions are inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Marketing, Midstream & Processing is a second source of earnings growth. Its adjusted operating income was 893 in Q3 2026 against 307 a year earlier (table in USD million). The company reports a record contribution from the Mongstad refinery. For this to continue, refinery and gas and LNG margins must hold.
quotes: Strong Marketing, Midstream and Processing results with record contribution from the Mongstad refinery

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Power segment table and Note 3. The conditions for continued growth are inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Renewable power is growing but is not yet profitable at the adjusted operating level. Renewable generation was 1.15 TWh in Q3 2026 against 0.91 (26%), while total generation fell 4% to 1.32 TWh. The Power segment's adjusted operating income was still negative at (5) (table in USD million). Growth needs new capacity to come on stream and the segment to reach positive earnings. Equinor also reports a US gas-fired power plant acquisition.
quotes: Acquired gas-fired power plant in the US

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 2026 key figures and balance sheet.
growth_thesis.claim: Cash generation and a stronger balance sheet support growth in distributions. Cash flow from operations after taxes paid was 8,142 in Q3 2026 against 5,334 (53%), and net debt to capital employed adjusted fell to 3.8% from 17.8% at 31 December 2025. The cash dividend per share was 0.39 against 0.37, with a buy-back of up to USD 3 billion for 2026. For this to continue, operating cash flow must keep covering dividends, buy-backs and capital expenditure.
quotes: Share buy-back of up to USD 3 billion for 2026

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the income statement and the buy-back notice. The mechanism is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Share count reduction lifts per-share growth. Weighted average shares outstanding were 2,374 million in Q3 2026 against 2,527 million a year earlier, and adjusted earnings per share were 1.20 against 0.37. For this to continue, buy-backs must continue; the fourth 2026 tranche was under way as of 24 November 2026.
quotes: Please see below information about transactions made under the fourth tranche of the 2026 share buy-back programme for Equinor ASA (OSE:EQNR, NYSE:EQNR, CEUX:EQNRO, TQEX:EQNRO).

growth_thesis.basis: The figures are stated. The link to growth is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Capital expenditure fell while production grew, so growth did not need higher spending. Capital expenditures and investments were 8,860 in the first nine months of 2026 against 9,848 (a 10% decrease) (table in USD million). For growth to continue without higher spending, the new fields already under development must keep delivering.

material_events.basis: Stated in the company 6-K (P2); the press report N1 repeats it.
material_events.claim: Equinor cut its 2026 production growth guidance back to around 3 percent from the around 4 percent it gave with the third-quarter results. It said temporary shut-ins at Bacalhau and Visund reduce average production by 15-20 mboe per day for the year.
quotes: Based on the incidents in Brazil and on the Norwegian continental shelf, Equinor changes its production guidance back to around 3 percent growth for 2026.

material_events.claim: A dropped-object incident on the Bacalhau FPSO in Brazil caused production to be shut down. The shutdown is expected to last roughly five to eight weeks. No one was injured.
quotes: On 18 November, a dropped-object incident occurred on the Bacalhau FPSO.

material_events.claim: A fire in the emergency power switchboard room at the Visund field means the field will be shut down for around two months.
quotes: As previously communicated, the Visund field will be shut down for around two months following a fire in the emergency power switchboard room on 4 November.

material_events.claim: Johan Castberg production was temporarily cut to a minimum because oil offloading is not currently possible. Work is under way to restore safe offloading.
quotes: In recent days, production at Johan Castberg has been temporarily reduced to a minimum as offloading of oil is currently not possible.

material_events.basis: Stated in the segment note of the 6-K interim report. The size relative to group results is not assessed here.
material_events.claim: Equinor recognised net impairments in E&P Norway and E&P International in the third quarter. They mainly related to updated production profiles on a cross-border producing asset on the Norwegian Continental Shelf.
quotes: In the third quarter 2026, net impairments in E&P Norway and E&P International mainly related to updated production profiles on a cross-border producing asset on the Norwegian Continental Shelf.

material_events.basis: Stated in Note 3 of the 6-K interim report.
material_events.claim: Equinor agreed to sell its remaining 20% interest in the Peregrino field in Brazil. Completion is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026 or the first quarter of 2027, subject to approvals. The related assets and liabilities are classified as held for sale.
quotes: Equinor has agreed to sell its remaining 20% interest in the Peregrino field.

material_events.basis: Stated in Note 3 of the 6-K interim report.
material_events.claim: Equinor entered into an agreement to acquire 87.71% of the Class A shares of the Lackawanna Energy Center, a gas-fired power plant in Pennsylvania. It will be accounted for as an equity-method joint venture in the Power segment.
quotes: On 6 August 2026, Equinor entered into an agreement to acquire 87.71% of the Class A shares of Lackawanna Energy Center, a gas-fired power plant in Pennsylvania, US.

material_events.basis: Stated in Note 3 of the 6-K interim report. The exact closing date is not stated in the extract.

quotes: A gain before tax of USD 467 million has been recognised in the second quarter within the E&P International segment and reported as Other Income in the Consolidated Statement of Income.

material_events.basis: Stated in the Q3 6-K (P1) and the buy-back 6-K (P3).
material_events.claim: The Q3 release announced a fourth tranche of the 2026 share buy-back programme of up to USD 1,125 million. The buy-back is under way and shares are being repurchased.
quotes: Fourth tranche of the share buy-back of up to USD 1,125 million
